metadata.description: The best go-to-market agent skills, powered by moltable — lead enrichment, account research, TAM building, and outbound prep, run by your AI agent against live data.

plugins.name: moltable
plugins.description: Production GTM workflows on moltable, the agent-native enrichment-table platform. Use when the user wants to enrich a list of leads or companies, build a TAM list, research accounts before outbound, or operate any part of the moltable platform (CLI verbs `auth`, `workbook`, `table`, `column`, `row`, `run`, `stop`, plus the REST API for connections / views / webhooks / API keys). Bundles four foundation skills: auth-and-profiles (credentials), build-enrichment-table (the GTM workhorse — scaffolds workbook + columns + import + run + export), run-and-watch-jobs (execution + monitoring with live SSE progress), and long-tail-fallback (curl recipes for the REST surface the CLI doesn't cover). Triggers include 'enrich this CSV', 'build me a list of X', 'research these accounts', 'watch the running enrichment', and any moltable-shaped request.
